notes.title: Deluxe Edition: Select Julia’s Outfit, an update about Statues and Skins
notes.notes:
https://cdn-uploads.oppaiman.com/125053806_30-08-2024-09-44-20-160_Julia_Outfit.png 
Hello, my dear FreshMen!

I’m very excited today! We had A LOT of progress this week, and there’s a lot to tell you!

Firstly, you were very hyped about the Deluxe Edition, so I went to work right away to see what we could deliver in a timely manner. Our most popular extras for the Deluxe Edition were: Digital 3D Printable Statues of Characters, and Skins. Those are also the most technically challenging items in the list, so we started with them!

I talked to a lot of 3D Sculptors this week, to find those that would give us the best result possible. Two of them are already lined up, and will start working on statues next week.

We’ll start with a Julia Statue, and, if there really is a demand for them, we’ll produce more. 

If we confirm there’s a demand, we’ll be able to create a few of them for the Deluxe Edition. You’ll choose which characters, of course, as well as their pose and clothing style!

This week, I want you to pick your favorite outfit for Julia’s Statue! Let us know in the comments!

Now, about the skins. We made a quick and dirty Proof-of-Concept this week, to validate our hypothesis, and, while it did work way better than expected, there are still a few technical things we have to perfect before I can tell you for sure that it’ll be possible. 

If works, you’ll be able to select character skins in a few scenes every episode. We’re working very hard to make it possible, but it’s important that we keep our expectations in check. 

There’s a reason most 3D Visual Novels don’t have skins, and it’s because it’s a difficult and complex process, full of moving parts and intricacies. 

Having said that, I’m very, very excited about this! It’ll be an amazing new piece of tech that we have mastered, and it’ll improve player experience in all our games. We’ll do our best to bring skins to you!

We’re also making steady progress on Season 2, and Susan’s sex scene is coming out beautifully! I’ll bring you screenshots starting next week. I think this scene will be one of our best scenes, and can’t wait to share more with you!

What a week, huh! This was an amazing one! A lot of work done, a lot of new tech coming, production flowing. It amazes me how much our team is capable of. A team filled with talented and passionate people is unstoppable, and this week proves it. We started the week with scary challenges on our table, and finished Friday dominating them!

Thank you so much for your support, and for making it all possible! Together, we’re making incredible things!

See you soon,

f1r3

I’m very fired up, and can’t wait to share these new stories with you! Thank you so much for your kindness and support! It’s thanks to you that we can bring these wonderful stories to life!

notes.title: Status Update: Season 2 Episode 3, Episode 4 and Forbidden Fantasy Chapter 3
notes.notes:
https://cdn-uploads.oppaiman.com/6846890_10-05-2024-06-18-28-052_StatusUpdate-05-10%20copy.png
Hello, my dear FreshMen!

Today is Friday, and it means it’s time for updates! 

We’re making fast progress on FreshWomen Season 2 Episode 3, and I’m very happy with how we’ve advanced over the past few weeks. I’m testing a few new ideas in our pipelines, and one of them seems to be working extraordinarily well.

Specifically, I’m now personally responsible for the polishing stage. This means that artists no longer have to make final fixes on renders, such as: deal with clippings, cloth simulation, polishing expressions, shader adjustment, etc. Instead, they can focus all of their efforts on Blocking, Lighting and Facial Expression.

These changes to our pipeline, along with our new character rig (with faster performance), seems to have increased our productivity (but also our work in progress). I’ll keep watching our numbers in order to observe two things: 1 - If this trend is indeed true and if it impacts our final quality, 2 - If I won’t become a bottleneck by adding these task to my stack.

If my hypothesis is correct, these changes can result in faster updates, and will become permanent.

Speaking of updates, this is our progress summary of Season 2 Episode 3 Part 1:

 Blocking: 7 scenes are blocked, 2 in progress;
 Lighting: 6 scenes done, 2 in progress, 1 to go;
 Facial Expression: 5 scenes done, 3 in progress, 1 to go;
 Cloth Simulation and Polish: 2 scenes done, 3 in progress, 4 to go;
 Animations: 7 animations done, 8 in progress, 16 to go;
 Characters, Script and Storyboards are done!
 Voice Acting is done, except for Lily’s now extended sex scene.

This progress makes me very excited! Season 2 Episode 3 is hilarious, sexy, and I’m very hyped to get it in your hands!

Forbidden Fantasy Chapter 3 is making fast progress too, and we’ve blocked almost everything! Here’s a summary of our progress so far:

 Blocking: 8 scenes are blocked, 1 in progress;
 Lighting: 2 scenes done, 6 in progress, 1 to go;
 Facial Expression: 2 in progress, 7 to go;
 Cloth Simulation and Polish: 9 to go;
 Animations: 2 animations done, 6 in progress, 20 to go;
 Characters, Script and Storyboards are done!
 Voice Acting is done.

We’re progressing quickly, and Chapter 3 is absolutely STUNNING. Honestly, the Zhara sex scene is one of the prettiest scenes I’ve seen, EVER!

This week we also shared the Story Outline for FreshWomen Season 2 Episode 4, and it was approved by you! This is awesome news, and our writers are already writing the script! Episode 4 will be the last episode of Season 2, and we’ll end this season with a bang! 

Starting the preproduction for Episode 4 also means we’ll soon start to turn our gears for a Steam Release of Season 2. We’re aiming for a second semester release! Stay tuned for more news!

As always, I’d like to thank you for your support! We’re very amazed by how much you guys have supported and helped us, and it’s a huge pleasure to create this games for you!

See you soon, 

f1r3

notes.title: Status Update: Season 2 Episode 3, Episode 4 Story Outline and Forbidden Fantasy
notes.notes:
https://cdn-uploads.oppaiman.com/6846890_03-05-2024-09-27-04-382_ep8%20deansagreement_046.jpg
Hello, my dear FreshMen!

We’re finishing another great week of work!

This week we continued working on FreshWomen Season 2 Episode 3 and Forbidden Fantasy Chapter 3, and they’re coming out nice! Season 2 Episode 3 is our funniest episode to date, and I can’t wait to share it with you. In it, you’ll resolve your issues with Donna, have a sexy re-encounter with Lily and participate in a series of hilarious challenges!

Here’s a progress summary of Season 2 Episode 3 Part 1:


 Blocking: 6 scenes are blocked, 1 is ongoing, 2 to go;
 Lighting: 3 scenes done, 3 in progress, 3 to go;
 Facial Expression: 3 scenes done, 3 in progress, 3 to go;
 Cloth Simulation and Polish: 1 scene done, 2 in progress, 6 to go;
 Animations: 5 animations done, 4 in progress, 22 to go;
 Characters, Script and Storyboards are done!
 Voice Acting is done, except for Lily’s now extended sex scene.


We’re making steady progress, and Season 2 Episode 3 Part 1 may come sooner than expected! Our new character rig and Motion Capture pipeline changed the game for our artists and animators, and it’s quite amazing to see they work without lag and with more efficient tools. I’m very excited to see what the future holds!

In other news, we’re finishing up the story outline for FreshWomen Season 2 Episode 4. This will be the last episode in Season 2, and I want to hear your opinions about the ending. So, if you don’t mind full spoilers and want to help us make a great ending, we’ll share our story outline next week, with a full feedback questionnaire!

Forbidden Fantasy has also made a lot of progress, and the first Zhara animations are already spectacular. We’re gearing up for a lot of great releases over the next few months, so make sure to stay tuned!

Thank you so much for your support and for helping us create the games we’re passionate about! It’s all thanks to you!

See you soon,

f1r3

notes.title: FREE VOICE UPDATE is out now!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42153694/313260aa9ed0fcd25922799aa3e3cdc702ab9ff9.jpg


Voice Update is here! It’s finally time!


We are very excited to bring you this early Christmas gift. The Voice Update is a Major Update that brings FreshWomen Season 1 to a brand-new level.

It's a whole new immersive experience, where we put you right in the middle of the action!

Feel the vibration, the sounds, and the sensuality of each moment.

 
This Major Update includes:

· Voice Acting for Episodes 1–5
· More than 5,600 voice lines.
· Intense moaning sounds
· Background noise, interaction sounds, breathing and more.
· Added Japanese, Korean and Czech translation
· Improved game support for 720p and low-end computers


This update will be applied automatically to the Steam Version, so all you have to do is download FreshWomen Season 1 on Steam and make sure it’s updated.

This gift we're sharing with you is our way of thanking you guys for all your love and support this year. It's also the result of the hard work of the entire Oppai-Man team, especially the talented voice actors and sound designers, who managed to make Season 1 even better.

We really hope you enjoy it.

 
Oppai-Man Team
